why: When the LLM line-wraps a long string value, the raw newline makes json.loads/JSON.parse throw. Recovered by _tolerant_json_loads (py) and tolerantParse (ts) — written twice, so they can drift.

input.prose:
```json
{"action": "replace", "target_text": "Confidential Information means any information
disclosed by either party.", "new_text": "Confidential Information means any non-public information disclosed by either party."}
```
